answer: Each agent posts a $500 bonded deposit tied to one identity before the island epoch opens, and the bond stays locked on the ledger until grading closes. A vine verifier samples the agent's past answers, replays the derivation under a fresh seed, and compares the result with the stored trace. One honest agent risks 1 bond of $500; 10 fakes must lock 10 bonds worth $5,000, so capital cost scales linearly with every clone. Peers check the public bond ledger, slash deposits whose grades diverge from consensus, and freeze repeat offenders for the next ripple epoch.
